about: Reads whose questions cannot be asked again exactly, so their answers are matched to the paid run that made them by when they were stored (UTC) and by the answer's fields. Each window runs from the paid command's start to the next paid command's start (the session transcript's tool calls; 'line' is the transcript line, session eb18d2fc). Answers that a replay matched exactly are left out here; they are recorded with their images.

reads.command: pay.sh read3.py (a 60-code pilot at line 92947, then all codes)
reads.why_not_replayed: read3.py places each print by its map position from the sheet transforms of the day (k8/labread2.npz); today's transforms give other positions

reads.command: pay.sh rotpilot.py 0 30 zon2000/rotpilot.json (run three times, lines 104307-104360)
reads.why_not_replayed: a pilot; not recorded by replay
replayed exactly (702 tiles); any other answer stored in its window is listed here
the places come from an old solve (zon2000/c_cwb_pfitf1.npz) and the script was changed after its paid run
the districts come from an old solve's walls (tag cws)
